conclusion: Bluepoint remains an unbuilt U.S. leaseholding project owned 50:50 through GIP's Seaway Energy Holdings and Ocean Winds' OW North America. The April 27, 2026 settlement suspends duties and contemplates future cancellation, but BOEM still describes cancellation as conditional and no final cancellation, ownership transfer, or dissolution was identified. The legal owners remain active until completion is evidenced.
